title: Liver FAST ZT00 Replicate 1
characteristics_ch1: strain: C57BL/6J | age: 8 weeks | timepoint/condition: ZT00 after 24-hr fasting
ch_timepoint_condition: ZT00 after 24-hr fasting
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from liver and skeletal muscle with TRIzol (Invitrogen), followed by precipitation with isopropanol and ethanol. | RNA libraries for each group were prepared as described in the TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation v2 Guide (Illumina).
data_processing: Basecalling performed using RTA version 1.18.64 | Demultiplexing performed using CASAVA version 1.8.2 | Alignment to reference assembly mm10 and known splice junctions extracted from the RefSeq database performed using ELAND v2e (Illumina) | Mapping results filtering performed using in-house tools | Read counting for each gene and normalization to RPKM values performed using in-house tools | Exon Intron Split Analysis (EISA) implemented in-house following the protocol reported in Gaidatzis et al., Nat. Biotech., 2015 | Genome_build: mm10 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Gene expression results (RPKM values) of the standard RNAseq analysis are reported in the Excel file RNAseq_expression_results.xlsx for all 72 replicates. Exonic and intronic expression results (RPKM values) resulting from the EISA analysis described in Gaidatzis et al., Nat. Biotech., 2015, are reported in the Excel files EISA_exonic_expression_results.xlsx and EISA_intronic_expression_results.xlsx respectively for all 72 replicates.
contact_address: Institute for Genomics and Bioinformatics 236, Info & Computer Science Building 2
